output.reason: The breaking-change entry [ev-dea2079e5dc4] says the chart used to enable policy exceptions in all namespaces by default. The section context [ev-2bbc505de6bb] names the setting: users keep that behaviour by setting the Helm value `features.policyExceptions.namespace` to `*`. So only environments that use PolicyExceptions and leave this value unset are exposed. The proposed condition, gvk-in-use alone, is too broad because it also flags environments that already set the value explicitly; those environments are shielded and belong under overlap.

correction.statement: In Kyverno 1.13.0 the Helm chart no longer enables policy exceptions in all namespaces by default (CVE-2024-48921). Environments that use PolicyExceptions without setting features.policyExceptions.namespace are affected; setting it to '*' keeps the previous behaviour.
